title: Lamb dipole stability without sign condition
summary: For the 2D incompressible Euler equations on the half-plane, we establish Lyapunov stability of the Lamb dipole without sign condition on the vorticity. The main challenge arises from growth of the $x_{2}$ weighted norm for mixed sign vorticities, whereas this norm is conserved and responsible for dipole stability in the single signed vorticity case.
